request.initial_prompt: I had often heard the song before, and always with lively delight; for Bessie had a sweet voice,—at least, I thought so. But now, though her voice was still sweet, I found in its melody an indescribable sadness. Sometimes, preoccupied with her work, she sang the refrain very low, very lingeringly; "A long time ago" came out like the saddest cadence of a funeral hymn. She passed into another ballad, this time a really doleful one.

raw_segments.text: I had often heard the song before, and always with lively delight, for Bessie had a sweet voice,—at least, I thought so.
But now, though her voice was still sweet, I found in its melody an indescribable sadness.
Sometimes, preoccupied with her work, she sang the refrain very low, very lingeringly.
A long time ago came out like the saddest cadence of a funeral hymn.
She passed into another ballad, this time a really doleful one.
